reported_failed_attempts.attempt: Iterate individually maximal local circuit exchanges
reported_failed_attempts.failure_scope: A rational feedback family needs Omega(2^L) batches and never reaches its exact optimum; another circuit can shortcut it, so no universal circuit lower bound follows.

reported_failed_attempts.attempt: Acquire every signed closure by monotone basis growth
reported_failed_attempts.failure_scope: Inverse-positive blocks may have no admissible smaller subblock, and rectangular nonnegative right inverses need no inverse-positive square basis.

reported_failed_attempts.attempt: Protect objective by the same positive-circulation repair
reported_failed_attempts.failure_scope: For bounded nonconstant profit, a positive cost-neutral circulation is impossible. If it exists, the objective was constant on the closure space already.

reported_failed_attempts.attempt: Treat a newly tight facet as permanent progress
reported_failed_attempts.failure_scope: A maximal collective jump can hit facets slack at the unique global optimum; freezing them may exclude it.
